replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven’t. Maths isn’t a priority for me, so I don’t seek out tools or help for it. My focus is on subjects I enjoy, like computer science.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: I’m not sure—I’d probably need to look it up. Maths isn’t my strong suit, so I avoid diving into details unless absolutely necessary.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimensions by finding patterns. You calculate covariance matrices, eigenvectors, and eigenvalues—it’s complex! If you’re not into maths, it might feel stressful, but tools like Python can automate most of the work.
replies.According to you, how can LLMs be used t: LLMs could make maths more interactive by explaining concepts in simple terms or generating practice problems. They could also adapt to a student’s level, making it less intimidating for those who struggle.
